task:
BUILD .fastops/worktree-compactor.js (under 60 lines). Cleanup tool that identifies which worktrees in .city-worktrees/ can be safely removed.

STEP 1: READ .fastops/city-session.js to understand how worktrees are created and what states they can be in (ACTIVE, DONE, FAILED, CLEANED, MAX_TURNS).
STEP 2: List .city-worktrees/ and check each dir: does it have uncommitted changes? Does it have a matching session in .fastops/.sessions/?
STEP 3: Build worktree-compactor.js that:
  - Scans .city-worktrees/ directories
  - For each, checks: (a) is there a matching .fastops/.sessions/ JSON? (b) what is the session status? (c) are there uncommitted changes worth preserving?
  - Categories: SAFE_TO_REMOVE (session done/failed, no unique changes), HAS_ARTIFACTS (has uncommitted changes or unique files), ORPHANED (no matching session file)
  - Outputs a report: {safeToRemove: [...], hasArtifacts: [...], orphaned: [...]}
  - Has --execute flag that actually removes SAFE_TO_REMOVE worktrees (git worktree remove)
  - Default is dry-run (report only)
STEP 4: Run in dry-run mode and verify the categorization makes sense.

IMPORTANT: Be conservative. Never delete a worktree with uncommitted changes without explicit --force.
